title: Advanced English

scope.focus: Post-C2 English for learners who already command general English at CEFR C2: precision, register, rhetoric, stylistics, advanced writing, literature, literary criticism, linguistics where useful, and high-level academic/professional expression.
includes: Academic and professional writing beyond general C2
delegates: General English below C2 is outside this track except for targeted remediation when a genuine prerequisite gap is discovered.

entry_prerequisites: General English proficiency at approximately CEFR C2 level
